title: Fix build artifact download and provide full source-code ZIP export

requirements.text: Make the in-app download links for build artifacts work by ensuring the files requested by the Dashboard exist as static assets at `/artifacts/app-build.zip` and `/artifacts/SOURCE_CODE.md` in production builds.

quotes: SI PORQUE EL ZIP QUE ME MUESTRAS NO DESCARGA EL COGIGO FUENTE DE LA PAGINA

acceptanceCriteria: When the app is built and served, a browser request to `/artifacts/app-build.zip` returns HTTP 200 and downloads a ZIP file (not HTML).
When the app is built and served, a browser request to `/artifacts/SOURCE_CODE.md` returns HTTP 200 and downloads the markdown file.
The Dashboard 'Full Project Export' section shows download buttons only when the corresponding artifact paths are actually reachable (consistent with `useStaticArtifactAvailability`).

requirements.text: Add a downloadable ZIP export that contains the actual project source tree (at minimum: `backend/` sources and `frontend/` sources/config needed to rebuild), and expose it as a static file under `/artifacts/` so users can download the full website source code directly from the app.

quotes: SI PORQUE EL ZIP QUE ME MUESTRAS NO DESCARGA EL COGIGO FUENTE DE LA PAGINA

acceptanceCriteria: A new source export ZIP is produced that includes the editable source files (not only compiled artifacts) so a developer can inspect/rebuild the project offline.
The source export ZIP is available as a static asset under `/artifacts/` and can be downloaded via the browser.
The Dashboard provides a clear download action for the source ZIP and the download succeeds in a production build.

requirements.text: Update the local packaging workflow scripts (e.g., `frontend/scripts/package-artifact.sh` and related docs) so that running the documented command produces: (1) the deployable build ZIP, (2) `SOURCE_CODE.md`, and (3) the full source-code ZIP, and stages/copies these artifacts into the frontend static public artifacts folder so the app can serve them at `/artifacts/...`.

quotes: SI PORQUE EL ZIP QUE ME MUESTRAS NO DESCARGA EL COGIGO FUENTE DE LA PAGINA

acceptanceCriteria: After running the packaging workflow locally, all downloadable artifacts are present in the location served by the frontend at runtime (the `/artifacts/` path).

`frontend/artifacts/DEPLOY_README.md` and `frontend/scripts/README.md` clearly state what each download contains (build ZIP vs source-code ZIP vs SOURCE_CODE.md) and where they appear inside the extracted ZIP(s).
The packaging workflow does not remove or break the existing `app-build.zip` output; it remains generated as before.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them instead).
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; only add backend changes if required to support the source export request.
All user-facing text in UI/docs added or changed must be in English.
nonGoals: Adding third-party storage, external databases, or external file hosting for artifacts.
Adding new authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Implementing real-time transfer mechanisms (e.g., WebSockets) for downloads.
